description: This file contains functions and types related to managing SSH sandbox sessions, including creating, configuring, running commands, and uploading directories via SSH. It includes utility functions for building SSH commands, parsing SSH configs, and handling sensitive key data.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH key and certificate material by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and expanding escaped characters.

methods.name: function buildSshFailureMessage(stderr: string, exitCode?: number): string { buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Builds a user-friendly failure message based on SSH stderr output and exit code.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a shell command string from an array of command parts, shell-escaped.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a remote execution command string with environment variables and working directory.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Builds the argument vector for invoking SSH, including config, host, and optional TTY settings.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from SSH config text, writing config to a temporary file.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from SshSandboxSettings, including key material and config.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Removes temporary files associated with an SSH sandbox session.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes a command over SSH sandbox session, capturing stdout/stderr and handling failure.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a local directory to the SSH target using tar over SSH, ensuring safe symlink handling.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Recursively verifies that symlinks within directory do not escape the root directory.
